name: CRT Monitor

doc:
### PROPOSAL-17 — CRT Monitor - **slug**: `crt` - **Vibe**: A curved-glass tube monitor in a 1990s office — phosphor glow, rolling scanlines, slight barrel distortion, and that soft chromatic halo around bright text. - **Best for**: Posting history and the agency publishing feed — everything looks played back off a dusty tube. Adjectives: warm, retro-physical, glowy. - **Palette** (dark theme, `is_dark: true`): | Token | Value | Usage | |---|---|---| | `--bg-canvas` | `#0c0a08` | Warm near-black tube backplane | | `--bg-surface` | `#171310` | Panel fill on the glass | | `--bg-surface-elevated` | `#221c16` | Raised panels, hover fills | | `--border-subtle` | `#30271d` | Faint bezel hairlines | | `--border-default` | `#443726` | Standard card borders | | `--border-focus` | `#ffcf5c` | Warm phosphor focus outline | | `--text-primary` | `#ffe9c2` | Warm white phosphor headings | | `--text-secondary` | `#d8bf94` | Body text | | `--text-muted` | `#947d58` | Dimmed captions, timestamps | | `--color-action` | `#ffb347` | Warm amber action fills | | `--color-action-hover` | `#e69a35` | Action hover (deeper amber) | | `--color-earnings` | `#8fd66a` | Green-phosphor earnings | | `--color-earnings-hover` | `#77bd54` | Earnings hover (deeper green) | | `--color-automation` | `#6cc6d8` | Cyan-phosphor automation accents | | `--color-alert` | `#ffab4a` | Amber warnings | | `--color-danger` | `#ff7355` | Warm red failed states | | `--color-action-glow` | `rgba(255, 179, 71, 0.20)` | Amber halo behind action icons | | `--color-earnings-glow` | `rgba(143, 214, 106, 0.18)` | Green halo behind earnings icons | | `--color-automation-glow` | `rgba(108, 198, 216, 0.18)` | Cyan halo behind automation icons | - **Typography**: Display: `"VT323", "Silkscreen", monospace` for oversized numerals. Sans: `"ChicagoFLF", "Press Start 2P", "Inter", sans-serif` fallback at 500-700 — use sparingly, prefer mono. Mono: `"IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace` for body. Headings carry a soft 1px text-shadow of `--color-action-glow` (phosphor bloom). KPIs `tabular-nums`. - **Radii & Borders**: Barrel-curve everywhere — cards `rounded-2xl` (1rem), buttons `rounded-lg`, inputs `rounded-md`, mimicking glass curvature. 1px borders with a faint outer glow (no hard shadows — depth comes from the tube). - **Component Patterns**: - **Buttons**: Soft-fill with warm text and a 2px glow shadow (`0 0 8px var(--color-action-glow)`); hover intensifies the bloom. Primary = amber fill, dark text. Focus = 2px warm outline. - **Cards**: Rounded panels with a subtle inset vignette (`inset 0 0 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.55)`) — the tube's dark corners. A scanline overlay (3px repeating gradient) sits inside every card. - **Badges/Status**: Rounded chips with a phosphor dot; publishing pulses with a slow "refresh flicker" (opacity 1 -> 0.7 -> 1, 1.2s). Failed = warm red text with red glow, never a filled banner. - **Tables**: Rounded outer frame, inner 1px grid; rows hover with a faint amber wash. Timestamps in mono, dimmed. - **Forms/Inputs**: Rounded fields, 1px borders, inner vignette; focus = warm amber border + soft glow. Caret blinks like an electron gun. - **Loading**: A horizontal bright line that "rolls" down the surface every 3s (refresh band); determinate = a glowing bar with bloom on the leading edge. - **Signature detail**: The vignette + scanline + bloom triad — every surface reads as curved glass, and bright text always bleeds a little light. - **Motion & Animation**: Soft and analog: 200-300ms ease-out with a gentle bloom on entry (opacity 0 -> 1, brightness 0.8 -> 1). No hard snaps; occasionally a one-frame flicker on state change. - **Signature Preview Snippet**: ```html
09:42:11 PUBLISHED tiktok-8821.mp4
```
